summary: The file browser composition showcases the required components with good overall structure, but contains visual clipping artifacts on dialog elements, an overlapping jump-to-latest control, and recurring typography spacing defects.

issues.title: Progress bar track overflows dialog bounds
issues.description: The storage progress track extends beyond the white card boundary into the dark container backdrop.
issues.evidence: The dark horizontal track line spans horizontally past both the left and right edges of the white storage dialog card.
issues.suggestion: Constrain the progress bar container width to 100% of the dialog inner padding.

issues.title: Button overlaps activity feed text
issues.description: The floating jump-to-latest button obscures the lowest feed entry text.
issues.evidence: The circular black button sits directly on top of the 'launch-budget.xlsx' label in the activity panel.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable feed or offset the button placement.

issues.title: Unintended spaces in text strings
issues.description: Multiple labels exhibit unnatural word breaks and spacing.
issues.evidence: Sidebar shows 'Enginee ring' and table shows '20 25' and 'la unch-budget.xlsx'.
issues.suggestion: Fix string values and ensure consistent font kerning.
